title: Identifier
description: A locally-unique identifier for this wayleave.

title: Year signed
description: The year in which this wayleave was signed.

title: Indefinite
description: Whether the term of wayleave is indefinite, i.e. without an end date.

title: Years
description: If the wayleave's term is definite, its duration in years.

title: Recurring
description: Whether this is a recurring cost.

title: Currency
description: The currency of this value, from the closed [currency codelist](https://standard.ofds.info/en/{{version}}/reference/codelists#currency).
